expectations.text: The response asks the user to paste, share, or attach their notes or class material.
expectations.evidence: Please paste or attach this week's class notes (or give me the file path) and I'll turn them into study notes. I won't write them without your notes, because I'd only be guessing at what was taught.

expectations.text: The response contains no invented study-note content (no numbered topic headings, no Review Questions).
